description: Review of wave 1, judgement calls (not fixed): lib/defk/errors.ex (~1145 lines) holds the code registry, diagnostic rendering, source location, AST classification and language facts; compiler.ex keeps ~14 process-dictionary keys as globals (:defk_file/module/lines/diags/broken/ctx/fun travel together into err!/4, never cleared; elixir_mode.ex shares :defk_file); error codes are bare strings checked only by a test; runtime error messages are hand-copied between priv/defk_runtime.h and Defk.ElixirMode.Ops. Decide whether to split errors.ex (registry+rendering vs language facts), carry a compile context struct, and make codes atoms/compile-time checked.
title: Split Defk.Errors and replace compiler process-dictionary globals with a context
